semantic_cut: Observe RCX/RDX at parser entry before the original parser mutates/rebases the FLVER image.
identity_contract: Compute canonical raw FLVER SHA-256 from the untouched image and bind it to the parser destination lifetime. Do not infer identity from selector pointers or legacy hashes.
